frontmatter.title: Lead Developer
frontmatter.company_description: Self-driven development work focused on building real-world applications, academic systems, and mobile tools across various domains including education, fitness, and games.

node.html:
• Served as Lead Developer across multiple projects from design to deployment, overseeing technical decisions and execution
  • Quizton: Engineered an AI-powered quiz generator that extracts questions from PDF lectures using NLP, with admin/teacher tools
  • NoteFlash AI: Built a mobile app that converts handwritten notes to adaptive flashcards using OCR and user performance tracking
  • ShapeShift: Developed a fitness app that recommends workout plans based on BMI and user goals, with challenge modes and trackers
  • Edelstein Labyrinth: Led development of a 2D fantasy RPG-style maze game in Unity, designing mechanics, sprites, and levels
  • Applied full-stack principles, integrated APIs and databases, and maintained code repositories using Git and GitHub
  • Freelance web developer with iBuild.PH (2023 – Present): front-end and back-end work for client websites, UI implementation, and database integration
  • Open to new freelance projects, reach out through the contact section or LinkedIn
